item.name: 07 RoleInterest actions
Accept flow

request.description: Mutates seeded backend application to accepted and creates ProjectMembership. Re-running after accept may return 400 because the RoleInterest is no longer pending. Re-run seed_demo_data to reset.

item.description: Mutating accept scenario. Do not run together with checks that require the original pending application unless you reset seed data.

item.name: Reject flow

request.description: Mutates seeded designer invitation to rejected. Re-running after reject may return 400 because the RoleInterest is no longer pending. Re-run seed_demo_data to reset.

item.description: Mutating reject scenario. Do not run together with accept invitation for the same interest without resetting seed data.
